# LessWrong

LessWrong ports the styling of the LessWrong 2.0 forum into Obsidian, matching its colors and column widths for a familiar rationalist layout. Its recorded description recommends light mode as the closest visual match.

![LessWrong screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/outsidetext/lesswrong-obsidian/HEAD/preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "LessWrong"
    author: "outsidetext"
    repo:   "outsidetext/lesswrong-obsidian"
    slug:   "lesswrong"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/lesswrong"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/outsidetext/lesswrong-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/outsidetext/lesswrong-obsidian/HEAD/preview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply LessWrong 2.0 forum styling to Obsidian, matching colors and column widths for a familiar rationalist layout. Prefer light mode for the closest visual match."
}
```
